test_title: PYST 8: SSC JE ME- General Awareness (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following items may NOT be treated as an intermediary good?

options.text: Maida produced in a flour mill
Maida used in a biscuit factory
Maida used in a house to make paratha
Maida used to produce bread in a bakery

solution:
The correct answer is __**Maida used in a house to make paratha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An intermediate good is an incomplete good that goes as input for further finishing.
 
• Thus, in the production chain, Intermediate goods lie between raw materials and finished goods.
 
• The goods that don't need any more processing are referred to as final goods. These products, usually referred to as consumer goods, are created with the intention of being consumed directly by the final user. The goods that companies utilize to produce goods or services are referred to as intermediate goods.
 
• A **consumer good**, also known as a final good or finished product, is made from an intermediate item.
 
• The following are examples of **final goods**: **Items purchased by households are intended for consumption in their whole**. For instance, television, milk, prepared meals, medications, and more. It also includes the products that businesses buy to raise funds or for investment purposes.
 
• **Maida used in a house to make paratha** is an example of the final good.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Intermediate goods** which are meant either:

 
 
• For further production
 
• Forresale in the same year
 
• Intermediate goods are used to produce other goods.
 
• The value of intermediate goods is not included in the estimation of national income.
